what: A background-colored curtain split into 20px square cells — when the page opens, the cells clear in .9s from the center outward (distance from center .75 + random .25 order), when a link to another page is clicked, the same order in reverse covers from the edges in .55s before navigating.

options.reveal: Duration of clearing from the opened page (sec), default 0.9
options.cover: Cover length after press (seconds), default 0.55 — the next page is only called once fully covered, so the transition is delayed by this much
options.jitter: Share of randomness mixed into the cell order (0~1), default 0.25 — 0 gives a neat rectangle from the center, 1 is fully random
options.cols: Cell size as screen width ÷ this cell count — if given, used instead of cell (example 24, phone 10)
options.each: GSAP grid stagger each — delay in seconds per cell of distance. When set, the reveal and cover length becomes the farthest cell distance × each, in place of reveal·cover (Brand .01 → about .27s on a 24-cell screen)
options.order: If shuffle, GSAP stagger { grid, from: "random" } Like this, it shuffles and hands out cell distances from the top-left corner (lights on and off at random, not from the center — sasuke)
options.ease: Progress curve: GSAP name or ”0.65,0,0.35,1”, default power1.inOut · none if cells are evenly spaced
options.delay: Delay before clearing on the opened page (seconds), default 0 — sasuke .1

use: <body data-fx="cell-iris-veil"> — For frequent, app-like navigation use data-fx-cell-iris-veil="reveal: 0.4; cover: 0.25"

from.where: shared.js GC.pixels (20px black cell curtain — reveal .9s · cover .55s power1.inOut, order = Chebyshev distance × .75 + random × .25)

shared.js page transition (swup JsPlugin) — background-colored cells sized like a 24-column grid (10 on phone) switch on in random order at 0.01s intervals to cover the page (out), then after the new page is mounted and .1s passes, they switch off the same way (in) — cols: 24; each: .01; order: shuffle; ease: none; delay: .1 (cell color is --kf-surface when the original is a white surface)

note: Painted on a single canvas so it stays light even with thousands of cells. Cell color reads --kf-bg
